AI.practical_contributions: 对市场监管者和投资者具有启示意义：当市场出现一系列利好信息且投资者情绪高涨、过度反应于非基本面信息时，应警惕资产价格泡沫的形成风险。

title: Price Discovery and Arbitrage Efficiency under Infrastructure Severance: Evidence from MOEX-CME Derivative Pairs, 2019-2026
affiliations: The National Research University - Higher School of Economics and The National Research University - Higher School of Economics

detail.title: Price Discovery and Arbitrage Efficiency under Infrastructure Severance: Evidence from MOEX-CME Derivative Pairs, 2019-2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available financial market data and does not involve human participants or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper studies how the severance of cross-border clearing, settlement, and convertibility infrastructure between the Moscow Exchange (MOEX) and the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) group affected the cross-venue price-discovery process for three derivative contract pairs that reference the same underlying real-world asset: gold (MOEX GLD versus COMEX GCF), silver (MOEX SILV versus COMEX SIF), and Brent crude (MOEX BR versus ICE BZF). Using daily settlement data from 1 January 2019 to 30 April 2026 and the canonical price-discovery triple-the Hasbrouck Information Share, the Gonzalo-Granger Component Share, and the Putniņš Information Leadership Share, estimated on a Johansen vector error-correction model-we document three results. First, the long-run cointegrating relation is preserved across the structural break of 24 February 2022, with the cointegrating coefficient remaining within one standard error of negative one in every pair and sub-sample. Second, the speed of error-correction on the MOEX leg falls by roughly 55-65%, lengthening the half-life of disequilibrium from one or two trading days to between one and a half and five trading days. Third, the price-discovery role of MOEX collapses for gold (Component Share falling from 0.475 to 0.100) while rising for Brent (from 0.196 to 0.665), the latter consistent with the re-anchoring of the rouble-denominated Brent contract onto regionally segmented Russia-relevant crude. Endogenous structural-break detection on the cointegrating residual locates the dominant break within 13 calendar days of 24 February 2022 for all three pairs. The paper contributes the first venue-pairwise price-discovery study of an integrated derivatives market subjected to abrupt infrastructure severance, and shows that on daily data the Hasbrouck bounds are too wide to support a single-number leadership inference, so the Component Share is the more reliable summary statistic.

title: AfCFTA and the Extensive Margin of Ghanaian Exports: Evidence on Product Diversification, Market Entry, and Survival

detail.title: AfCFTA and the Extensive Margin of Ghanaian Exports: Evidence on Product Diversification, Market Entry, and Survival

declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the effects of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) on the dynamics of Ghana's exports using highly disaggregated HS6-product data covering 196 destination markets. Moving beyond aggregate trade flows, the analysis investigates the impact of AfCFTA on the intensive, extensive, entry, exit, and survival margins of trade. Estimating the extensive margin within a gravity framework with PPML, which is well-suited to handling zero trade flow and heteroskedasticity, the results indicate that AfCFTA has strengthened Ghana's export performance by expanding market participation, encouraging entry into new destination-product markets, reducing export exits, and improving the persistence of export relationships. A series of robustness checks, including alternative treatment years, major commodity exclusions, and event-study analyses, confirm the stability of the findings. The results suggest that the gains from AfCFTA extend beyond higher trade volumes to encompass export diversification and the sustainability of export relationships, highlighting the Agreement's potential to support Ghana's long-term trade integration and structural transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用加纳高度细化的HS6产品层面数据，研究了非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）对加纳出口动态的影响，发现AfCFTA不仅提升了出口总量，还通过扩大市场参与、促进新产品-市场进入、减少退出和增强出口关系持续性，推动了加纳的出口多元化和结构转型。
AI.research_question: AfCFTA如何影响加纳在集约边际、扩展边际、进入、退出和生存边际等多个维度的出口表现？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多聚焦于自由贸易区对贸易总量的影响，而忽视了其对出口动态（如多元化、进入退出和关系持续性）的深层作用。本文旨在填补这一空白，深入理解AfCFTA对加纳出口结构转型的潜在贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易边际理论（集约边际与扩展边际）、引力模型（特别处理零贸易流和异方差性的PPML估计方法）。
AI.method: 使用高度细化的HS6产品层面数据，覆盖196个目的地市场；采用泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）的引力模型来估计扩展边际；同时进行稳健性检验（替代处理年份、排除主要大宗商品、事件研究分析）。
AI.findings: AfCFTA显著提升了加纳的出口表现：扩大了市场参与，促进了企业进入新的目的地-产品市场，减少了出口退出，并增强了出口关系的持续性（生存率）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AfCFTA的影响从传统的总量贸易效应拓展到多维度的贸易动态（进入、退出、生存等边际），丰富了区域贸易协定对发展中国家出口结构转型的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，证明AfCFTA不仅能增加贸易额，更能促进出口多元化和贸易关系的可持续性，从而支持加纳乃至非洲的长期经济转型与区域一体化战略。

title: Who Gains from a US-EU Free Trade Agreement? Relative Wages, Employment, and Welfare in General Equilibrium

detail.title: Who Gains from a US-EU Free Trade Agreement? Relative Wages, Employment, and Welfare in General Equilibrium

declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funds for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the labor-market and welfare implications of the proposed Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) between the United States (US) and the European Union (EU) using a multi-country, multi-sector general equilibrium framework with endogenous labor mobility across sectors. Trade-cost changes associated with existing regional trade agreements (RTAs) and the hypothetical TTIP are estimated using a gravity model and subsequently incorporated into a general equilibrium framework solved in changes following the exact hat algebra approach. The analysis quantifies the effects of TTIP on relative wages, sectoral employment, consumer prices, and worker welfare across countries. The results indicate that TTIP would generate substantial gains for EU member states, particularly smaller and less-developed economies, through higher relative wages, lower consumer prices, and improved worker welfare. In contrast, the effects on the US are modest, with slight declines in relative wages but limited changes in overall welfare. Most non-member countries experience welfare losses as trade and production are diverted toward the integrated transatlantic market. The findings suggest that while TTIP would strengthen economic integration and improve labor-market outcomes within the EU, its benefits would be unevenly distributed across countries, creating winners and losers through trade diversion and changes in international competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文利用多国多部门一般均衡模型（含部门间劳动力流动）研究TTIP对劳动力市场和福利的影响。结果显示：TTIP将为欧盟成员国（尤其是较小较不发达经济体）带来显著收益（更高工资、更低价格、更高福利），但对美国影响温和，多数非成员国因贸易转移而遭受福利损失。
AI.research_question: TTIP对美国与欧盟的劳动力市场（相对工资、部门就业）和工人福利有何影响？这些影响在不同国家间如何分布？
AI.motivation: TTIP作为大型区域贸易协定，其劳动力市场效应（尤其是跨部门劳动力流动与福利分配）尚未被充分量化评估，现有研究多聚焦于整体贸易效应而忽视劳动力市场异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多国多部门一般均衡框架（含内生部门间劳动力流动）；引力模型估计贸易成本变化；精确帽子代数（exact hat algebra）求解均衡变化。
AI.method: 首先用引力模型估计现有RTA及假设TTIP的贸易成本变化，再将贸易成本变化嵌入多国多部门一般均衡模型，采用精确帽子代数方法求解相对工资、部门就业、消费价格和工人福利的变化。
AI.findings: （1）TTIP为欧盟成员国（尤其是较小较不发达经济体）带来显著收益：相对工资上升、消费价格下降、工人福利改善；（2）对美国影响温和：相对工资略有下降，整体福利变化有限；（3）多数非成员国因贸易转移（贸易和生产转向整合的跨大西洋市场）遭受福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将内生劳动力跨部门流动纳入多国多部门一般均衡贸易模型，系统量化了TTIP对劳动力市场和福利的异质性影响，揭示了贸易协定的分配效应机制（贸易转移与国际竞争力变化如何塑造赢家与输家）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为TTIP的政策评估提供了基于劳动力市场异质性的量化证据，提醒政策制定者注意贸易协定的非对称分配效应——欧盟内部收益不均，且非成员国可能受损。

title: Geopolitical Risk and Sustainability Disclosure: From Materiality to Operational Framework Under IFRS S1
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Geopolitical Risk and Sustainability Disclosure: From Materiality to Operational Framework Under IFRS S1
detail.abstract:
Purpose. This paper addresses the structural operationalisation gap in the ISSB sustainability disclosure architecture with respect to geopolitical risk. While IFRS S1, IFRS S2, and the SASB Standards acknowledge geopolitical risk within the value chain definition, and the proposed SASB amendments (July 2025; March 2026) introduce limited sector-specific coverage, no cross-industry taxonomy, transmission channel framework, scenario architecture, quantification methodology, or response classification framework exists within the ISSB ecosystem, leaving entities unable to discharge the disclosure obligation the standards’ own value chain definition implies.

Design/Methodology/Approach. The paper adopts an interpretive methodology grounded in systematic regulatory document analysis of nine primary ISSB instruments, a synthesis of academic and practitioner literatures on geopolitical risk and sustainability disclosure, and primary illustrative evidence from three contemporaneous geopolitical episodes – the 2026 Iran-Gulf conflict, China’s rare-earth element export controls, and the 2022 Russia-Ukraine energy cascade – drawn from corporate disclosures, institutional reports, and audited financial statements.

Findings. The paper establishes five original contributions: (1) a materiality argument that geopolitical risk satisfies IFRS S1 paragraphs 17–18, 55(a), and B13–B37 and the SASB cross-cutting threshold, and that IFRS S1-level treatment is architecturally superior to any single General Issue Category placement; (2) a four-category taxonomy – Security Risk, Economic Statecraft, Financial Systems Risk, and Institutional Erosion; (3) a multidirectionality principle with five documented properties – simultaneity, asymmetric geography, non-linearity, intraconnectivity, and positional asymmetry; (4) a five-layer IFRS-compatible disclosure framework; and (5) a STAAR response taxonomy (Share, Transfer, Avoid, Accept, Reduce) with Share analytically prior for systemic risks, grounded in Olson’s (1965) and Ostrom’s (1990) collective action theory.

Originality/Value. This paper provides the first cross-industry geopolitical risk disclosure framework operable within the existing IFRS S1 architecture, addressing a gap in the sustainability disclosure literature. The framework is grounded in the ISSB’s own analytical methodology and is illustrated through primary-source evidence from the Ghanaian downstream petroleum sector and banking system – jurisdictions demonstrating the asymmetric consequences of the operationalisation gap for developing economy entities and their financiers.

AI.tldr: 本文指出ISSB可持续发展披露架构中存在地缘政治风险的结构性操作化空白，并首创了首个跨行业的、可在现有IFRS S1架构内运行的地缘政治风险披露框架，包含分类法、多方向性原则、五层披露框架及STAAR应对分类法。
AI.research_question: 如何填补ISSB可持续发展披露架构中关于地缘政治风险的结构性操作化空白，构建一个跨行业的、与IFRS S1兼容的地缘政治风险披露框架？
AI.motivation: 尽管IFRS S1、IFRS S2和SASB标准在价值链定义中承认了地缘政治风险，且SASB拟议修订引入了有限的特定行业覆盖，但ISSB生态系统中缺乏跨行业分类法、传导渠道框架、情景架构、量化方法或应对分类框架，导致实体无法履行其披露义务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体行动理论（Olson, 1965; Ostrom, 1990）；ISSB披露架构方法论；SASB跨领域阈值标准；IFRS S1第17-18段、55(a)段、B13-B37段。
AI.method: 解释性方法论，基于九项ISSB主要工具的系统性监管文件分析，学术与实践文献综合，以及三个当代地缘政治事件（2026年伊朗-海湾冲突、中国稀土出口管制、2022年俄乌能源连锁效应）的一手例证证据。
AI.findings: 建立了五项原创贡献：(1)地缘政治风险满足IFRS S1和SASB重要性阈值，且IFRS S1级处理优于任何单一通用议题类别；(2)四类别分类法——安全风险、经济治国术、金融系统风险、制度侵蚀；(3)多方向性原则及五个已记录属性——同时性、非对称地理性、非线性、内部连通性、位置非对称性；(4)五层IFRS兼容披露框架；(5)STAAR应对分类法（共享、转移、规避、接受、减少），其中"共享"对系统风险具有分析优先性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次构建了跨行业的地缘政治风险披露框架，填补了可持续发展披露文献中的空白；将集体行动理论（Olson & Ostrom）应用于系统性风险的披露应对分类中，提出"共享"应对的分析优先性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ISSB提供了可操作的跨行业地缘政治风险披露框架，帮助实体在现有IFRS S1架构内履行披露义务；通过加纳下游石油部门和银行体系的一手证据，揭示了操作化缺口对发展中经济体及其融资方的不对称后果。

title: AGOA and Africa's Welfare: A General Equilibrium Analysis with the Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood Estimator *
affiliations: and Central Bank of Liberia

detail.title: AGOA and Africa's Welfare: A General Equilibrium Analysis with the Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood Estimator *

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no funding for this research.

detail.abstract: Assuming a full-endowment framework, we employ the General Equilibrium Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood (GEPPML) methodology developed by Anderson et al. (2015) to estimate the welfare effects of the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) within a structural gravity setting. Using bilateral trade data for African countries and the United States (US), we conduct a series of counterfactual simulations that examine both the abolition of AGOA for all eligible countries and its extension to all non-eligible countries, while holding the effects of geography and colonial ties constant. The results indicate that eliminating AGOA reduces welfare in approximately 90% of eligible countries but increases welfare in about 95% of non-eligible countries. Conversely, extending the AGOA intervention to non-eligible countries generates measurable welfare gains for nearly all countries on the continent, especially new entrants. We further evaluate a reciprocal AGOA arrangement by granting comparable trade preferences to the US. Under this scenario, consumers in all eligible countries experience welfare improvements, although these gains are accompanied by losses for many producers across Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文运用结构引力模型和GEPPML方法，评估AGOA对非洲国家的福利效应。结果表明：取消AGOA会降低约90%受惠国福利但提升约95%非受惠国福利；将AGOA扩展至所有非洲国家能带来普遍福利增长；互惠性AGOA虽使受惠国消费者受益，但会损害非洲许多生产者的利益。
AI.research_question: AGOA（非洲增长与机会法案）对非洲国家的福利效应如何？取消、扩展和互惠化AGOA分别会产生怎样的福利影响？
AI.motivation: AGOA是美国对非洲的重要贸易优惠安排，但其福利效应的全面评估尚不充分，尤其是考虑一般均衡效应和不同政策情景下的影响差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引力模型（Structural Gravity）、一般均衡框架（Full-endowment framework）、Anderson et al. (2015)的GEPPML方法论
AI.method: 采用GEPPML（General Equilibrium Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood）方法，基于非洲国家与美国之间的双边贸易数据，在保持地理和殖民联系效应不变的情况下，进行系列反事实模拟。
AI.findings: （1）取消AGOA导致约90%受惠国福利下降，但约95%非受惠国福利上升；（2）将AGOA扩展至所有非洲国家，几乎整个非洲大陆都能获得福利改善，新加入国家获益尤为显著；（3）互惠性AGOA（给予美国同等贸易优惠）使受惠国消费者福利改善，但许多非洲生产者遭受损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将GEPPML方法系统应用于评估区域性贸易优惠安排的福利效应，丰富了结构引力模型在贸易政策评估领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AGOA的政策制定和改革提供了量化依据，揭示了不同政策情景（取消、扩展、互惠化）下非洲各国的福利分配差异，有助于政策制定者权衡各方利益。

title: Government Guided Funds and the Direction of Innovation
affiliations: Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business, Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business, Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business and Duke University

detail.title: Government Guided Funds and the Direction of Innovation
detail.abstract: We study Chinese central government guided funds (GGF), which invest through private venture capital partnerships while pursuing industrial policy objectives. We argue that, beyond the standard knowledge externality, private investors under-invest in discovering which technological directions are viable because the resulting information spills over to competing firms. By financing directional experimentation, GGF could help resolve technological uncertainty and guides entrepreneurial activity toward viable technologies. Using a shift-share instrument that combines national industry-level fundraising with predetermined provincial industry shares, we find that central GGF investment crowds in private venture capital, increases firm entry, and raises the share of R&D-intensive firms in targeted industry-provinces. Patent portfolios become more similar over time, consistent with convergence toward viable technological directions. In contrast, local GGFs generate weaker and less persistent effects, suggesting that geographically constrained industrial policies are less effective at resolving technological uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国中央政府引导基金（GGF）如何通过风险投资合伙机制解决技术方向发现中的信息外部性问题，促进产业政策目标的实现。
AI.research_question: 中央政府引导基金能否通过资助方向性实验解决技术不确定性，引导创业活动走向可行技术方向？
AI.motivation: 私人投资者在探索可行技术方向时存在投资不足，因为产生的信息会外溢到竞争对手，造成知识外部性之外的信息外部性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息外部性理论、方向性实验理论、产业政策理论
AI.method: 使用shift-share工具变量法，结合国家层面行业募资数据与省级行业份额数据
AI.findings: 中央GGF投资挤入私人风险投资、增加企业进入、提高目标行业省份中R&D密集型企业的比例；专利组合随时间趋同，表明向可行技术方向收敛；地方GGF效果较弱且不持久。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了技术方向发现中的信息外部性机制，拓展了产业政策与风险投资交叉领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府引导基金的设计提供实证依据，表明中央层面的产业政策比地方性的在地化政策更有效。

title: Ban, Permit, Scaffold, Integrate: A Framework for Evaluating Generative AI in Economics Education

detail.title: Ban, Permit, Scaffold, Integrate: A Framework for Evaluating Generative AI in Economics Education
detail.abstract: Generative AI has made conventional course-policy labels such as ban, permit, and integrate too general for evaluating teaching and learning. This paper uses the framework synthesis-a qualitative evidence synthesis method used in applied health and policy research-to analyze the emerging literature on generative AI in economics education. We propose to use a twodimensional framework for comparing the AI-augmented instructional conditions and learning outcomes that are being documented in literature. The first dimension is characterized by four course-design regimes: an AI-banned or no-AI diagnostic regime, an AI-permitted but unscaffolded regime, an AI-permitted scaffolded regime, and an AI-integrated or critique-based regime. The second dimension organizes various impacts of AI on learning into eleven outcomes within four broader domains: performance, learning process, AI-specific competence, and distributional or institutional conditions. Our analysis of the early evidence suggests that generative AI may be following a policy drift while its impact on learning is still poorly understood or mitigated. The results reported here are preliminary, based on a pilot corpus of nineteen studies coded as of May 20, 2026; an expanded and fully verified synthesis is in progress. The framework offers an empirically defensible method of utilizing emergent and rapidly growing peer-reviewed scholarship to systematically articulate strategic priorities for empirical education research and curricula design protocols in economics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成式AI使传统课程政策标签（禁止、允许、整合）过于笼统的问题，采用框架综合法分析经济学教育中生成式AI的新兴文献，提出一个二维分析框架：第一维度是四种课程设计制度（禁止/无AI诊断、允许但无支架、允许有支架、整合/批判式），第二维度将AI对学习的影响归纳为四个领域（表现、学习过程、AI特定能力、分配/制度条件）共11项结果。初步分析发现AI可能呈现政策漂移，其学习影响仍未被充分理解或缓解。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更精细的框架来评估和比较生成式AI在经济学教育中的不同教学条件及其对学习结果的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统课程政策标签（禁止、允许、整合）已不足以应对生成式AI带来的复杂教学情境，需要更系统的分类和评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架综合法（framework synthesis），源自应用健康与政策研究领域的定性证据综合方法；二维分析框架（课程设计制度维度 × 学习结果维度）。
AI.method: 框架综合法（定性证据综合），基于截至2026年5月20日的19项研究的试点语料库进行编码分析。
AI.findings: 初步发现生成式AI可能呈现政策漂移（policy drift），其对学习的影响仍未被充分理解或有效缓解；现有证据仍属初步阶段，更全面的综合正在进行中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个经验上可辩护的二维分析框架，为系统梳理AI增强教学条件与学习结果之间的关系提供了理论工具；将框架综合法从健康政策研究引入教育领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学教育中的实证研究优先事项和课程设计协议提供了系统的策略优先级判断方法；帮助教育者超越简单的禁止/允许二分法，采取更精细化的课程政策。

title: Audit Findings as an Input to Shareholder Monitoring: Evidence from Chinese State-Owned Enterprises
affiliations: and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics - School of Accounting

detail.title: Audit Findings as an Input to Shareholder Monitoring: Evidence from Chinese State-Owned Enterprises
detail.abstract: This study examines how using audit findings in shareholder monitoring affects audit practice. We exploit a unique Chinese regulatory setting in which state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in some jurisdictions must report all material misstatements identified by auditors to their monitoring shareholders, even when those misstatements are corrected in the audited financial statements. Although intended to strengthen oversight, this requirement generates unintended consequences. SOEs subject to the reporting requirement record significantly fewer audit adjustments than other SOEs and non-SOEs, but exhibit higher abnormal accruals and a greater likelihood of subsequent restatements. These findings suggest that when audit findings directly affect managerial career outcomes, shareholder monitoring based on those findings can discourage the recording of adjustments and undermine the quality of audited financial statements. Consistent with this mechanism, we show that audit adjustments are negatively associated with managers' promotion prospects in affected SOEs. Adjustment avoidance is also stronger when managers face greater career concerns near retirement and when the client is more important to the auditor. Our findings highlight that using audit findings for governance can distort audit practice when monitored managers can influence whether those findings are formally recorded.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，要求国企向股东报告审计发现的错报（即使已被更正）反而导致审计调整减少、异常应计利润增加和重述可能性上升，原因是管理层为避免影响职业晋升而阻止错报被正式记录。
AI.research_question: 将审计发现用于股东监督如何影响审计实务？
AI.motivation: 利用中国独特的监管制度——部分地区的国企必须向监督股东报告审计师发现的所有重大错报（即使已在审计报表中更正）——来检验这一要求的意外后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审计监督与高管职业激励理论，以及审计调整决策中管理层与审计师的博弈机制。
AI.method: 利用中国国企分地区信息披露要求的差异，采用准自然实验方法，比较受监管要求影响的国企与未受影响的国企和非国企在审计调整、异常应计利润和重述概率上的差异。
AI.findings: （1）受报告要求约束的国企记录的审计调整显著少于其他国企和非国企；（2）这些国企的异常应计利润更高，后续重述可能性更大；（3）审计调整与管理层晋升前景负相关；（4）临近退休的管理层和审计客户重要性更高的情形下，调整规避更严重。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了将审计结果用于公司治理可能产生的意外扭曲效应，拓展了审计调整决定因素的研究，阐明了管理层影响审计结果记录的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者设计监督机制提供警示：直接使用审计发现进行问责可能适得其反，需考虑管理层激励对审计质量的影响。

title: By Executive Command: The Escalation of Conservative Administrative Strategy from Reagan’s Mandate to Project 2025
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title: By Executive Command: The Escalation of Conservative Administrative Strategy from Reagan’s Mandate to Project 2025
detail.abstract:
Does the conservative movement of today represent a continuation or departure from that of the past? While some argue that a categorical shift has occurred, the precise nature and depth of that difference remain under-articulated. This thesis addresses that question by comparing two editions of Mandate for Leadership, comprehensive policy playbooks that have shaped Republican governance since the Reagan era. The comparative textual analysis that follows documents a dramatic escalation in the conservative movement’s willingness to enact its agenda by undermining the legal and institutional structure of the administrative state and expanding presidential authority. The 1981 Mandate treats constraints on presidential authority and bureaucratic neutrality as legitimate features of executive branch governance. The 2025 Mandate

rejects that premise entirely, dismantling the existing bureaucratic architecture and constructing a blueprint for a federal bureaucracy run exclusively by presidential command. Since Republican administrations often translate Mandate for Leadership directly into policy, these findings offer more than reflective insight. They provide a predictive framework for anticipating the institutional changes, policy proposals, and constitutional challenges likely to define Republican governance and the future of the American state.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较1981年版和2025年版《领导权授权》政策手册，揭示了保守主义运动从接受行政国家约束到彻底摒弃官僚中立、主张总统全权控制联邦官僚机构的剧烈转变，并为预测未来共和党治理提供了分析框架。
AI.research_question: 当今的保守主义运动是延续还是背离了过去？两版《领导权授权》所体现的保守主义治理理念发生了何种性质与深度的变化？
AI.motivation: 虽有学者认为保守主义发生了根本性转变，但对该变化的确切性质与深度仍缺乏清晰阐述，因此有必要通过系统比较两版政策手册来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政国家理论、总统权力理论、保守主义运动变迁理论
AI.method: 比较文本分析（Comparative Textual Analysis），对比1981年版与2025年版《领导权授权》手册。
AI.findings: 1981年版将总统权力约束和官僚中立视为行政分支治理的合法特征；2025年版彻底摒弃这一前提，主张拆除现有官僚架构，建立仅由总统命令运行的联邦官僚体系。保守主义运动破坏行政国家的法律与制度结构、扩张总统权力的意愿显著升级。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统界定了当代保守主义运动相对于过去的本质性断裂，为理解行政国家危机与总统权力扩张提供了经验证据和理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 由于共和党政府常将《领导权授权》直接转化为政策，研究结果不仅提供反思性洞见，更构建了预测机制，可用于预判共和党治理下的制度变革、政策提案及宪法挑战。

title: Forecasting Crop Carbon Sink Trends and Carbon Neutrality Contributions of the Planting Industry Using Machine Learning Methods
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: Forecasting Crop Carbon Sink Trends and Carbon Neutrality Contributions of the Planting Industry Using Machine Learning Methods
detail.abstract: The agricultural sector occupies a critical position in national carbon budgets, with the planting industry serving as both a significant carbon source and a vital carbon sink. Accurate forecasting of crop carbon sink trends and the quantification of carbon neutrality contributions from planting activities are essential for formulating effective climate mitigation policies. This study employs advanced machine learning methodologies to predict the trajectory of crop carbon sinks and assess the planting industry's role in achieving carbon neutrality. Drawing on a comprehensive dataset encompassing agricultural production variables, climatic factors, and land-use changes over multiple decades, the research integrates ensemble learning techniques, including random forest, gradient boosting, and long short-term memory networks, to model the nonlinear dynamics of carbon sequestration in major crop systems. The machine learning models demonstrate superior predictive performance compared to conventional econometric approaches, effectively capturing complex interactions between environmental drivers and agronomic practices. Key findings indicate that crop carbon sinks are projected to increase marginally over the next two decades, driven primarily by improved crop yields and expanded green manure coverage, yet this growth is offset by rising emissions from fertilizer application and mechanization. The analysis reveals that the planting industry's net carbon contribution to neutrality remains limited, with a carbon sink capacity that offsets only a fraction of total agricultural emissions. Specifically, under current management scenarios, the sector's carbon neutrality potential is constrained by persistent inefficiencies in nitrogen fertilizer use and residue management. The machine learning framework further identifies soil organic carbon content and irrigation intensity as the most influential predictors of sink variability. These results underscore the necessity of targeted interventions, such as precision agriculture and enhanced residue retention, to amplify the carbon sink function. The study concludes that while machine learning offers robust tools for forecasting and scenario analysis, achieving meaningful carbon neutrality in the planting industry requires synergistic policy measures that align technological innovation with sustainable land management. This research provides a quantitative foundation for integrating crop carbon sinks into national carbon accounting frameworks and supports evidence-based decision-making for agricultural climate strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用机器学习方法（随机森林、梯度提升、LSTM）预测农作物碳汇趋势并评估种植业的碳中和贡献。结果显示，未来二十年碳汇将小幅增长，但被化肥和机械化排放抵消，净碳中和贡献有限。土壤有机碳和灌溉强度是最关键的影响因素，需要精准农业和秸秆还田等干预措施来增强碳汇功能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法预测农作物碳汇趋势，并量化种植业对我国碳中和目标的贡献？
AI.motivation: 种植业既是重要碳源也是关键碳汇，准确预测其碳汇趋势和碳中和贡献对于制定有效的气候减缓政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳循环理论、碳中和理论、机器学习预测理论（集成学习与深度学习）
AI.method: 集成机器学习方法：随机森林、梯度提升、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）；数据集涵盖农业生产变量、气候因素和土地利用变化。
AI.findings: （1）机器学习模型预测性能优于传统计量方法；（2）作物碳汇未来二十年将小幅增长，主要驱动力为作物产量提升和绿肥覆盖增加；（3）增长被化肥施用和机械化排放所抵消；（4）种植业净碳中和贡献有限，碳汇仅能抵消农业总排放的一小部分；（5）土壤有机碳含量和灌溉强度是最重要的碳汇变异预测因子；（6）氮肥利用效率和秸秆管理效率低下制约碳中和潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习方法系统引入农业碳汇预测与碳中和贡献评估领域，建立了非线性动态碳汇建模框架，识别出影响碳汇变异的关键驱动因子。
AI.practical_contributions: 为将农作物碳汇纳入国家碳核算体系提供了定量基础；指出需通过精准农业、秸秆还田等针对性干预措施增强碳汇功能；为农业气候战略的循证决策提供支持。

title: The Market Response to Mergers and Nationalisation Announcements: Stock Market Evidence from the UK Banks

detail.title: The Market Response to Mergers and Nationalisation Announcements: Stock Market Evidence from the UK Banks
detail.abstract: In this paper I use standard event study methodology to explore two main issues in the UK banking industry. First, I attempt to show how the big five banks' domestic and cross-border mergers affected shareholders' wealth. Second, I present a timely empirical analysis of the Northern Rock bank crisis in which the effects of earnings, merger and nationalisation announcements are carefully examined. The event studies show no significant gains in either domestic or cross-border mergers. These results suggest a strong financial integration between the UK and Europe. For the Northern Rock case, the bank itself and the industry experienced a positive stock reaction when it announced an increase in earnings, but faced negative outcomes for the dividend cancellation. Interestingly, the nationalisation of Northern Rock appears to be unwelcome to the big five banks.

AI.tldr: 本文运用事件研究法分析英国银行业两大议题：五大银行国内外并购对股东财富的影响，以及北岩银行危机中盈利、并购和国有化公告的市场反应。
AI.research_question: 英国五大银行的国内与跨境并购如何影响股东财富？北岩银行危机期间，盈利公告、并购公告和国有化公告分别产生怎样的市场反应？
AI.motivation: 英国银行业并购活动频繁，但国内外并购的财富效应尚不明确；2007年北岩银行危机作为英国银行业重大事件，其不同公告的市场影响值得深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法（Event Study Methodology），基于有效市场假说，通过累计异常收益率（CAR）衡量公告事件的市场反应。
AI.method: 标准事件研究法，分析英国五大银行（国内及跨境）并购事件以及北岩银行危机相关公告（盈利、并购、国有化）前后的股票异常收益率。
AI.findings: 国内外并购均未带来显著股东财富增益，表明英国与欧洲金融市场高度一体化；北岩银行盈利增长公告带来正向反应，股息取消导致负面反应；五大银行对北岩国有化持负面态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为英国银行业并购财富效应提供经验证据，支持欧洲金融市场一体化假说；丰富银行危机中不同公告类型市场反应的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层和投资者提供并购决策参考（国内外并购无显著增益）；为监管机构提供危机期间公告策略的实证依据，提示国有化可能对同业产生负面溢出效应。

title: Machine Learning-Driven Evaluation of Sustainable Agricultural Practices and Carbon Emissions in China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Machine Learning-Driven Evaluation of Sustainable Agricultural Practices and Carbon Emissions in China
detail.abstract: This study investigates the application of machine learning techniques to evaluate the effectiveness of sustainable agricultural practices in mitigating carbon emissions across China's diverse agro-ecological regions. Leveraging a comprehensive dataset encompassing agricultural inputs, land-use patterns, climatic variables, and emission inventories from 2000 to 2023, we developed and compared multiple predictive models including random forest, gradient boosting machines, support vector regression, and deep neural networks. The random forest model demonstrated superior performance, achieving an R-squared value of 0.92 and a root mean square error of 3.8 Mt CO2-equivalent, significantly outperforming traditional econometric approaches. Feature importance analysis revealed that fertilizer application intensity, irrigation efficiency, and tillage practices were the most influential predictors of carbon emissions, collectively accounting for over 65% of model variance. The machine learning models identified substantial regional heterogeneity in emission reduction potentials: the North China Plain showed the highest mitigation potential through optimized nitrogen management, while the Yangtze River Delta benefited most from conservation tillage and straw return practices. Importantly, the models captured non-linear interactions between sustainable practices and emission outcomes, revealing threshold effects where emission reductions accelerate beyond certain adoption levels. Scenario analyses indicated that widespread adoption of integrated nutrient management and reduced tillage could decrease agricultural carbon emissions by 1825% by 2030 relative to baseline projections, with the most pronounced reductions in intensive cropping systems. However, the models also identified potential trade-offs, particularly in waterscarce regions where certain emission-reducing practices may increase irrigation demands. The predictive framework further enabled the identification of high-priority intervention zones where targeted policy support could yield maximum climate benefits. These findings demonstrate that machine learning approaches offer robust tools for evidence-based agricultural policy design, enabling the identification of context-specific sustainable practices that optimize emission reductions while maintaining productivity. The study concludes that data-driven evaluation of agricultural sustainability requires moving beyond simplistic linear models to capture the complex, region-specific dynamics of socio-ecological systems. This research provides a methodological foundation for developing adaptive management strategies that can respond to evolving climatic and economic conditions, supporting China’s dual goals of agricultural modernization and carbon neutrality.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用随机森林等多种机器学习模型，评估中国不同农业生态区可持续农业实践（如优化氮肥管理、保护性耕作、秸秆还田等）对碳减排的效果。随机森林模型表现最佳（R²=0.92），发现施肥强度、灌溉效率和耕作方式是影响碳排放的最重要因素，并识别出区域异质性和非线性阈值效应。情景分析显示，广泛采用综合养分管理和少耕技术，至2030年可减少农业碳排放18-25%。
AI.research_question: 机器学习技术如何有效评估中国不同农业生态区可持续农业实践对碳减排的效果？不同区域的最佳减排策略是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统计量经济方法难以捕捉可持续农业实践与碳排放之间的复杂非线性关系和区域异质性，难以支持精准的政策设计。需要更强大的数据驱动工具来评估农业碳减排潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习理论（随机森林、梯度提升机、支持向量回归、深度神经网络）；可持续农业与碳排放理论；区域异质性理论；阈值效应理论。
AI.method: 使用2000-2023年涵盖农业投入、土地利用、气候变量和排放清单的综合数据集，构建并比较随机森林、梯度提升机、支持向量回归和深度神经网络四种机器学习模型，通过特征重要性分析和情景模拟进行评估。
AI.findings: (1) 随机森林模型表现最优（R²=0.92, RMSE=3.8 Mt CO2-eq）；(2) 施肥强度、灌溉效率和耕作方式是三大关键预测因子（贡献>65%方差）；(3) 华北平原通过优化氮肥管理减排潜力最大，长江三角洲受益于保护性耕作和秸秆还田；(4) 存在非线性阈值效应；(5) 广泛采纳可持续实践可减排18-25%，但缺水地区存在减排-灌溉权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了机器学习方法在农业碳减排评估中超越传统线性模型的有效性；揭示了可持续农业实践与碳排放之间的非线性关系和阈值效应；构建了考虑区域异质性和复杂社会经济-生态动态的评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国不同农业生态区提供了针对性的可持续农业实践策略；识别了高优先级干预区域；支持中国农业现代化与碳中和双重目标的政策设计；为适应性管理策略提供了方法论基础。

title: Distributed Solar Adoption in Small Island Developing States Multiple Thresholds, Structural Barriers, and a Self-Funding Cross-Subsidy Mechanism
affiliations: Oukitel Mauritius Co. Ltd

detail.title: Distributed Solar Adoption in Small Island Developing States Multiple Thresholds, Structural Barriers, and a Self-Funding Cross-Subsidy Mechanism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is associated with Oukitel Mauritius Co. Ltd., a supplier of portable photovoltaic systems in the Mauritius market. The retail price observations used as calibration anchors were drawn from a competing independent specialist retailer; no factory-direct or wholesale price from the author's supply chain was used as any analytical input. The two central price ceilings are derived solely from publicly available tariff schedules, concessional financing rates, and solar resource data, without reference to any commercial price observation. No funding was received from Oukitel or any other commercial entity in connection with this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only publicly available aggregate statistical data and official tariff schedules. No human participants, patient data, or personally identifiable information was involved. Ethics approval is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Three structural barriers, two analytically derived price ceilings, and one self-funding cross-subsidy theorem, each computable from any country's tariff schedule and financing parameters without reference to retail data. Calibrated to Mauritius; Fiji as the flat-tariff boundary case; replicable across small island developing states whose residential tariff is progressive and whose utility attains near-universal billing coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三种结构性障碍、两种通过分析得出的价格上限以及一个自筹资金交叉补贴定理，所有这些都可以仅从任何国家的关税表和融资参数中计算出来，无需参考零售数据。该模型以毛里求斯为校准案例，斐济作为平关税边界案例，可推广至居民电价呈累进结构且公用事业实现近乎全覆盖计费的小岛屿发展中国家。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖零售数据的情况下，仅通过关税表和融资参数识别小岛屿发展中国家累进电价结构中的障碍，并设计可计算的价格上限和自筹资金交叉补贴机制？
AI.motivation: 解决小岛屿发展中国家（SIDS）在实施累进电价（IBT）时面临的独特结构性障碍，特别是缺乏零售数据导致交叉补贴设计困难的问题，为这些国家提供一种无需零售数据即可计算和优化电价结构的通用方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 累进定价理论、交叉补贴定理、结构性障碍分析框架、价格上限理论
AI.method: 理论推导与数值校准相结合。首先从理论上推导三种结构性障碍和两种价格上限，然后利用毛里求斯的关税表和融资参数进行校准，以斐济作为平关税边界案例进行验证，最后讨论向其他小岛屿发展中国家的可推广性。
AI.findings: 识别了累进电价结构中的三种结构性障碍，推导出两个分析性价格上限，并证明了一个自筹资金交叉补贴定理。该模型在毛里求斯和斐济的校准中有效，且可推广至满足居民电价累进且公用事业覆盖率高的小岛屿发展中国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个无需零售数据即可计算电价结构性障碍和价格上限的理论框架，建立了自筹资金交叉补贴定理，拓展了累进定价理论在特定发展中国家的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小岛屿发展中国家（如毛里求斯、斐济及其他SIDS）提供了一种实用的电价设计工具，帮助这些国家在不依赖昂贵零售数据的情况下优化电价结构，实现更有效的交叉补贴和社会福利目标。

title: Prediction of Agricultural Carbon Emission Peaks and Neutrality Pathways in China Using Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Prediction of Agricultural Carbon Emission Peaks and Neutrality Pathways in China Using Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: This study investigates the trajectory of agricultural carbon emissions in China and evaluates the potential for achieving peak emissions and carbon neutrality through the application of artificial intelligence methodologies. Employing a suite of machine learning algorithms, including random forest and gradient boosting machines, the research models the complex, non-linear relationships between agricultural activities-such as fertilizer application, livestock management, and energy use-and resultant carbon dioxide and methane emissions. The analytical framework integrates historical emission data from 2000 to 2023 with socioeconomic variables, including GDP per capita, rural population, and technological adoption rates. The machine learning models demonstrate superior predictive accuracy compared to traditional econometric approaches, capturing intricate interaction effects and temporal dynamics that conventional methods often overlook. Feature importance analysis reveals that nitrogen fertilizer use, livestock population density, and agricultural machinery energy intensity are the primary drivers of emission variability. Scenario simulations under three distinct policy pathways-business-as-usual, moderate mitigation, and aggressive decarbonization-indicate that China's agricultural sector is likely to reach its carbon emission peak between 2028 and 2032, contingent upon the rigor of implemented policies. Under the aggressive decarbonization scenario, which incorporates widespread adoption of precision agriculture, enhanced manure management, and a significant shift toward renewable energy in farm operations, emissions could decline by up to 45% from peak levels by 2050. The carbon neutrality pathway, however, requires additional negative emission strategies, such as biochar application and agroforestry expansion, to fully offset residual emissions from enteric fermentation and rice paddies. The findings highlight that while technological innovation and policy intervention can substantially reduce emissions, complete neutrality in the agricultural sector remains challenging without transformative changes in production systems and dietary patterns. This research provides a robust, data-driven foundation for policymakers to design targeted mitigation strategies and underscores the critical role of artificial intelligence in navigating the uncertainties inherent in long-term emission forecasting. The methodology offers a replicable framework applicable to other agricultural regions seeking to align with global climate goals.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用随机森林、梯度提升机等机器学习算法，基于2000-2023年历史排放数据和社会经济变量，对中国农业碳排放轨迹进行建模预测。研究发现：氮肥使用、牲畜密度和农机能源强度是主要排放驱动因素；在三种政策情景下，中国农业碳排放预计在2028-2032年间达峰；激进脱碳情景下，到2050年排放可从峰值下降45%；但要实现碳中和还需生物炭、农林复合等负排放策略以及生产系统和饮食结构的变革。
AI.research_question: 中国农业碳排放的演变轨迹如何？通过人工智能方法实现农业碳排放达峰与碳中和的潜力有多大？
AI.motivation: 农业部门是重要的温室气体排放源（尤其是CO₂和CH₄），传统计量经济学方法难以捕捉农业排放复杂、非线性的特征，需要更先进的AI方法来进行精确预测和政策评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习理论（随机森林、梯度提升机）；碳排放驱动因素理论；情景分析与政策模拟理论；农业碳达峰与碳中和路径理论。
AI.method: 采用随机森林和梯度提升机等机器学习算法，整合2000-2023年历史排放数据与社会经济变量（人均GDP、农村人口、技术采纳率），进行特征重要性分析，并设计三个政策情景（照常情景、中度减缓、激进脱碳）进行模拟预测。
AI.findings: (1) 机器学习模型预测精度优于传统计量方法；(2) 氮肥使用、牲畜密度和农机能源强度是主要排放驱动因素；(3) 中国农业碳排放峰值预计在2028-2032年间；(4) 激进脱碳情景下2050年排放可下降45%；(5) 实现碳中和需要生物炭、农林复合等负排放策略以及生产系统和饮食结构变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习方法系统应用于农业碳排放预测领域，揭示了传统方法难以捕捉的非线性交互效应和时序动态，建立了AI驱动下的农业排放预测理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供数据驱动的精准减排策略设计依据；识别出氮肥管理、精准农业、可再生能源转换等关键干预点；提供了可复制的方法框架供其他农业地区参考；明确了实现农业碳中和所需的额外负排放策略。

title: Maternal Early-Life Exposure to the Food Stamp Program and Birth Outcomes in the Next Generation
affiliations: , University of Wisconsin Milwaukee and Lafayette College

detail.title: Maternal Early-Life Exposure to the Food Stamp Program and Birth Outcomes in the Next Generation
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the intergenerational effects of early-life exposure to the Food Stamp Program (FSP) on birth outcomes. Employing a difference-in-differences approach with an interaction-weighted estimator, we assess how maternal FSP exposure during early life affects children’s birth outcomes in the next generation. Our results indicate significant improvements among children of Black mothers, including a 17.8-gram increase in birth weight and a 4.6% reduction in the incidence of low birth weight. In contrast, the corresponding estimates for children of White mothers are small and statistically insignificant. To explore potential mechanisms, we show that FSP exposure was associated with higher maternal education, shifts in fertility timing, improved prenatal health behaviors, and increased utilization of prenatal care. We further estimate that the program reduced the racial gap in low birth weight among second-generation infants by approximately 10%. Moreover, a back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the program generated a minimum social return of 13% through improvements in the later-life income of affected second-generation children.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了早期接触食品券计划（FSP）对下一代出生结局的代际影响，发现黑人母亲的后代出生体重显著增加、低出生体重率下降，并缩小了种族差距，产生了至少13%的社会回报。
AI.research_question: 母亲在早期生活中接触食品券计划（FSP）如何影响其后代（第二代）的出生结局？
AI.motivation: 检验安全网计划（食品券）是否存在跨代健康效应，并量化其对种族健康差距和社会回报的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际传递理论、早期生命起源假说（DOHaD）、人力资本理论
AI.method: 双重差分法（DID）结合交互加权估计量，使用历史政策变化来识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 黑人母亲后代出生体重增加17.8克，低出生体重率降低4.6%；白人母亲后代效应小且不显著；种族低出生体重差距缩小约10%；最低社会回报率为13%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为安全网计划的代际健康传递提供了因果证据，拓展了早期生活干预长期影响的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明食品券计划不仅能改善当代营养，还能通过改善下一代健康缩小种族不平等，具有显著的社会投资回报率。

title: Spatial Patterns and Hotspot Analysis of Adolescent Stunting in Ethiopia: Evidence from the 2016 Ethiopia Demographic and Health Survey (EDHS)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Gondar - Institute of Public Health, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Spatial Patterns and Hotspot Analysis of Adolescent Stunting in Ethiopia: Evidence from the 2016 Ethiopia Demographic and Health Survey (EDHS)
detail.abstract: AbstractBackground: Stunting remains one of the leading public health challenges among adolescents in low- and middle-income countries. Although Ethiopia has implemented several nutrition programs, chronic undernutrition among adolescent girls continues to be a significant concern because of its adverse effects on physical growth, cognitive development, reproductive health, and future economic productivity. Understanding the geographical distribution of stunting is essential for identifying high-risk areas and guiding targeted nutrition interventions. TMethods: A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted using nationally representative data from the 2016 EDHS. The analysis included adolescent girls aged 15–19 years with complete anthropometric and geographic information. Geographic coordinates of enumeration areas were linked with nutritional data for spatial analysis. ArcGIS 10.6 was used to assess spatial patterns through Global Moran's I, Incremental Spatial Autocorrelation, Local Moran's I, Getis–Ord Gi* hotspot analysis, and Ordinary Kriging interpolation. Spatial scan statistics were performed using SaTScan version 9.6 with the Bernoulli model to identify statistically significant clusters of stunting. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics and the prevalence of stunting.Results: The spatial distribution of stunting among adolescent girls was significantly clustered across Ethiopia. Global Moran's I demonstrated significant positive spatial autocorrelation, indicating that stunting was not randomly distributed. Local Moran's I identified high-high clusters primarily in Amhara, Tigray, Afar, and parts of the Southern Nations, Nationalities and Peoples' Region (SNNPR). Hotspot analysis further confirmed these areas as statistically significant hotspots of chronic undernutrition. Ordinary Kriging interpolation predicted elevated risks of stunting in unsampled locations within northern and northeastern Ethiopia. Spatial scan statistics detected significant primary and secondary clusters, with the primary clusters located in Tigray, Amhara, Afar, and northern Addis Ababa.Conclusion: Stunting among adolescent girls in Ethiopia exhibited significant spatial clustering. Northern and northeastern regions consistently demonstrated a higher burden of chronic undernutrition.

AI.tldr: 基于2016年埃塞俄比亚人口健康调查数据，采用空间分析方法发现埃塞俄比亚青春期女孩生长迟缓（矮小症）存在显著空间聚集性，北部和东北部地区是高负担热点区域。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚青春期女孩（15-19岁）生长迟缓的空间分布特征及其聚集区域在哪里？
AI.motivation: 埃塞俄比亚青春期女孩慢性营养不良问题持续严重，影响身体发育、认知发展、生殖健康和未来经济生产力，而了解其地理分布是识别高风险区域、指导针对性营养干预的关键前提。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间流行病学理论：利用空间自相关（Global Moran's I）、局部自相关（Local Moran's I）、热点分析（Getis-Ord Gi*）、克里金插值及空间扫描统计等方法，分析健康事件的非随机空间分布模式。
AI.method: 基于2016年EDHS全国代表性数据，纳入15-19岁完整人体测量和地理信息的青春期女孩。将枚举区地理坐标与营养数据关联，使用ArcGIS 10.6进行全局Moran's I、增量空间自相关、局部Moran's I、Getis-Ord Gi*热点分析及普通克里金插值；使用SaTScan 9.6的Bernoulli模型进行空间扫描统计。
AI.findings: （1）生长迟缓在青春期女孩中呈显著空间聚集性，非随机分布；（2）高-高聚类（热点）主要位于阿姆哈拉、提格雷、阿法尔及SNNPR部分地区；（3）热点分析确认这些区域为统计显著的慢性营养不良热点；（4）普通克里金插值预测埃塞俄比亚北部和东北部未采样地区存在较高风险；（5）空间扫描统计识别出显著的主次聚类，主聚类位于提格雷、阿姆哈拉、阿法尔及亚的斯亚贝巴北部。
AI.theory_contributions: 将空间分析方法系统应用于青春期女孩生长迟缓研究，揭示了埃塞俄比亚该健康问题的空间非随机性及地理聚集模式，拓展了营养流行病学的空间分析应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出埃塞俄比亚北部和东北部（提格雷、阿姆哈拉、阿法尔等）为生长迟缓高发热点区域，为政府和卫生组织在这些地区优先配置资源、实施针对性营养干预提供了科学依据。

title: The Geography of Incomplete Recovery: Spatial Persistence and Compound Vulnerability in United States Housing Wealth, 2007–2021

detail.title: The Geography of Incomplete Recovery: Spatial Persistence and Compound Vulnerability in United States Housing Wealth, 2007–2021
detail.abstract: Did U.S. local housing markets that suffered the deepest Great Recession losses recover during the 2020–2021 pandemic boom, or does recovery failure persist? Using IPUMS American Community Survey microdata, the FEMA National Risk Index, and Census TIGER/Line geometry, I build a real housing-wealth recovery index (2012–2021) for 2,351 PUMAs across the contiguous United States and show that recovery is strongly and durably unequal across space. It is highly clustered (Moran’s I = 0.70, p < 0.001), with 360 statistically significant Low-Low cores in the Great Lakes industrial corridor, Appalachia, and the Mississippi Delta. A k-means typology isolates a 968-PUMA “Persistently Depressed” cluster that combines the weakest recovery with the highest social vulnerability (mean SOVI = 59.6) and the lowest community resilience, a compound-disadvantage footprint that offers a regionally coherent targeting criterion for Community Reinvestment Act assessment areas. I then ask whether deeper recession losses causally shaped recovery, and find the question cannot be cleanly identified: the apparent catch-up in a naive ordinary-least-squares regression is largely a mechanical artifact of mean reversion and measurement error, and a county-level instrumental-variables design cannot resolve it, because no available instrument for recession severity is both strong and valid. The causal effect is therefore not identified in this setting, a cautionary result for the mechanical use of shift-share instruments when housing is the outcome. The paper’s robust, policy-relevant contribution is its documentation of persistent spatial inequality and compound disadvantage.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用IPUMS ACS微观数据、FEMA国家风险指数和人口普查地理数据，构建了2012-2021年美国2,351个PUMA的住房财富恢复指数，发现大萧条期间受损最严重的地区在2020-2021年疫情繁荣期并未实现恢复，空间不平等持续存在。研究识别出968个PUMA组成的“持续萧条”集群，该集群兼具最弱的恢复能力、最高的社会脆弱性和最低的社区韧性。因果分析表明，无法干净地识别衰退程度对恢复的因果效应，因为OLS回归中的追赶效应主要是均值回归和测量误差的人为产物。
AI.research_question: 美国大萧条期间遭受最严重损失的本地住房市场，在2020-2021年疫情繁荣期是否实现了恢复，还是恢复失败持续存在？
AI.motivation: 大萧条对住房市场的冲击具有高度异质性，但后续恢复过程是否同样不平等、以及疫情繁荣期是否弥合了这种差距，此前缺乏系统性证据。作者希望揭示住房财富恢复的空间模式，并评估因果关系识别的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间经济不平等理论、社区韧性与社会脆弱性理论、均值回归与测量误差计量理论
AI.method: 构建住房财富恢复指数（2012-2021）；空间自相关分析（Moran's I）；k-means聚类分析；OLS回归与工具变量法（县级IV设计）。
AI.findings: （1）住房市场恢复呈现高度且持久的不平等，空间聚类显著（Moran's I=0.70）；（2）360个统计显著的Low-Low核心区集中在五大湖工业走廊、阿巴拉契亚和密西西比三角洲；（3）识别出968个PUMA的“持续萧条”集群，兼具最弱恢复、最高社会脆弱性（平均SOVI=59.6）和最低社区韧性；（4）衰退程度对恢复的因果效应无法干净识别，OLS呈现的追赶效应是均值回归和测量误差的人为产物，IV估计因工具变量不满足强度和有效性而失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了住房市场恢复中空间不平等持久存在的理论机制，证明了均值回归和测量误差可能人为制造“追赶”的假象，为因果识别方法在住房经济学中的应用提供了重要的警示性结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出“持续萧条”集群作为复合劣势区域，为《社区再投资法》评估区域的确定提供了地域连贯的目标标准；为政策制定者识别真正需要干预的持续恢复失败区域提供了可操作的空间识别框架。

title: Securitization, the financial crisis and macroprudential policy: a DSGE analysis
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Securitization, the financial crisis and macroprudential policy: a DSGE analysis
detail.abstract: Securitization acts as an amplifier, significantly exacerbating the economic contractions triggered by adverse financial shocks. ‌To explore this mechanism,‌ we develop a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model that incorporates an explicit securitization channel. Using this model, we investigate the effects of macroprudential policies on economic stability and social welfare. In the model, commercial banks engage in regulatory arbitrage by establishing special purpose vehicles (SPVs). These SPVs finance off-balance-sheet loans by issuing asset-backed securities (ABS), with banks providing implicit guarantees. The model successfully replicates the crisis-era dynamics of key aggregate variables. We further evaluate two macroprudential policies: risk retention  (mandating banks to retain a portion of issued ABS) and capital regulation. Our findings indicate that a higher retention rate enhances economic stability by lowering ABS default risk, but the effect is threshold‑dependent. A higher capital adequacy ratio also reduces fragility by strengthening banks' incentives to support distressed ABS. Crucially, the quantitative effect of each policy on economic fluctuations depends on the stance of the other. ‌Finally, we show that the welfare effects of these macroprudential policies are highly non-linear and fundamentally depend on the interaction between risk retention and capital regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建包含证券化渠道的DSGE模型，发现证券化会放大金融冲击对经济的负面影响。研究发现，风险留存和资本监管两类宏观审慎政策的效果存在相互依赖关系，且福利效应高度非线性。
AI.research_question: 证券化如何放大金融冲击对经济的影响？宏观审慎政策（风险留存与资本监管）如何影响经济稳定和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 证券化在金融危机中被视为经济下行的放大器，但缺乏系统性模型来刻画其传导机制，以及不同宏观审慎政策之间的交互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型；监管套利理论；隐性担保机制；风险留存与资本监管政策交互理论。
AI.method: 构建包含商业银行设立SPV进行监管套利、发行ABS并提供隐性担保的DSGE模型，模拟金融危机时期关键宏观变量动态，并比较不同政策组合的 welfare 效果。
AI.findings: 1. 证券化显著放大负面金融冲击的经济收缩效应；2. 更高的风险留存率通过降低ABS违约风险增强经济稳定性，但存在阈值效应；3. 更高的资本充足率通过强化银行支持困境ABS的激励降低脆弱性；4. 两种政策对经济波动的影响相互依赖；5. 福利效应高度非线性，取决于两者的交互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在DSGE框架中明确刻画证券化渠道（SPV+ABS+隐性担保）如何作为金融冲击的放大器；揭示风险留存与资本监管之间的政策交互机制及其阈值效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计宏观审慎政策组合提供定量依据：不同政策之间存在非线性的交互影响，单一政策调整可能效果有限，需协调搭配使用。

title: When Some Investors Have Superior AI: Evidence from China's Stock Connect Programs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chongqing University - School of Economics and Business Admininstration and University of Melbourne

detail.title: When Some Investors Have Superior AI: Evidence from China's Stock Connect Programs
detail.abstract: We examine whether unequal access to generative AI (GenAI) widens information disparities among investors. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that informed trading, measured by VPIN, for Chinese Stock Connect constituent firms tradable by foreign investors increases significantly after the launch of ChatGPT relative to non-constituent firms, which are predominantly traded by domestic investors with limited GenAI access before 2025. This effect is stronger for firms with higher foreign trading intensity or information-processing costs, suggesting that the increase is driven by foreign investors’ GenAI-enabled information-processing advantages. Consistent with this, the predictive power of foreign investors’ trades on future stock returns increases significantly after ChatGPT’s launch. Finally, the relative VPIN gap between Connect-constituent and non-constituent firms disappears following the release of DeepSeek in 2025, when domestic investors gained access to more comparable GenAI tools. Our findings suggest that the uneven diffusion of GenAI can widen informational inequality in financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用ChatGPT发布作为外生冲击，发现生成式AI（GenAI）的不平等获取会加剧中外投资者之间的信息不对称，导致市场信息不平等扩大；当国内投资者获得类似工具（DeepSeek）后，这一差距消失。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI的不平等访问是否会加剧投资者之间的信息差距？
AI.motivation: GenAI快速普及但各国/群体访问受限，尚不清楚这种技术获取不平等是否会影响资本市场信息效率与公平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、技术赋能理论、市场微观结构理论。
AI.method: 双重差分模型（DID），以ChatGPT发布为外生冲击，使用VPIN衡量知情交易，对比A股沪深港通成分股（外资可交易）与非成分股（主要境内投资者交易）。
AI.findings: （1）ChatGPT发布后，外资可交易的成分股VPIN显著上升；（2）该效应在外资交易强度高、信息处理成本高的公司中更强；（3）外资交易的股价预测能力增强；（4）2025年DeepSeek发布后，成分股与非成分股的VPIN差距消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了技术不平等对金融市场信息效率影响的理论，揭示了GenAI作为信息处理工具如何改变市场微观结构中的信息优势分布。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示监管机构需关注AI工具获取不平等对市场公平性的潜在冲击；为投资者理解技术变革下的信息动态提供实证依据。

title: The Determinacy of Eective Demand: A Dynamical-Systems Generalisation of Marglin's Price-Adjustment Models
affiliations: University of Brasília (UnB)

detail.title: The Determinacy of Eective Demand: A Dynamical-Systems Generalisation of Marglin's Price-Adjustment Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or any personal or confidential data. The analysis is theoretical and uses only publicly available, aggregate macroeconomic time series (Federal Reserve Economic Data, FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis). Ethics approval and informed consent were therefore not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by a postdoctoral fellowship from the Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico (CNPq), Brazil. The funder had no role in the study design; in the collection, analysis, or interpretation of data; in the writing of the manuscript; or in the decision to submit the article for publication.

detail.abstract: This paper analyses the five price-adjustment specifications of Marglin (2021, Chapters 5–7) using the qualitative theory of planar dynamical systems. Its central result is one of determinacy: the investment–saving feedback ∂[I(ρ)−sY]/∂Y < 0 is a necessary and sufficient condition for the macroeconomic equilibrium to be determinate (isolated). The supply-driven price rules (Viner, Walrasian rigid wages) leave output indeterminate: their goods-supply and marginal-cost schedules are mutual inverses, so the Jacobian is singular along an entire curve and the equilibrium set is a one-dimensional continuum — the rigorous form of Marglin's (2021, p. 186) "overdetermination." Determinacy is restored only by a second independent relation beyond profit maximisation. Two such relations are available: the labour-supply schedule (Walrasian flexible wages) and effective demand (the IS relation). Either yields a determinate, stable equilibrium — the flexible-wage model is a stable node (Marglin 2021, p. 220), the IS-feedback model a stable focus — but they select different equilibria, and which governs depends on the relative speed of price and wage adjustment (Marglin's overdetermination, §6.16). The economic question is therefore which closure describes observed economies. Where the IS feedback governs, the equilibrium is isolated and, under a saving condition, locally a stable focus; on the economically admissible (scarcity-bounded) region it is globally asymptotically stable, by Bendixson's criterion and the Poincaré–Bendixson theorem. We do not claim global asymptotic stability on all of ℝ²₊₊: with an unbounded investment response the trace of the Jacobian turns positive at extreme profitability, so stability is regional. All model parameters are calibrated from FRED quarterly data: α = 0.330, s = 0.176; the output-adjustment speed, identified from the near-unit-root mean reversion of the IS gap, has a median-unbiased estimate θ₂ ≈ 0.22 (95% CI [0.01, 0.42], excluding zero); we adopt θ₂ = 0.25. Across the identified range [0.18, 0.55] the equilibrium is a determinate stable focus with period 9.3–11.7 years (Juglar band); at θ₂ = 0.25 the eigenvalues are −0.083 ± 0.150i, oscillation period ≈ 41.8 quarters (≈ 10.5 years) and half-life ≈ 8.4 quarters. An active Taylor rule is the demand-side relation that restores determinacy; the zero lower bound is the regime in which that relation goes slack and indeterminacy returns. The US IS gap (1960–2024) is stationary and mean-reverting (a Dickey–Fuller test rejects a unit root), closing toward equilibrium rather than diverging — evidence for the effective-demand closure over the labour-supply closure; under a broad gross-saving measure the gap is moreover persistently negative, the chronic demand shortfall that policy offsets.

AI.tldr: 本文运用平面动力系统定性理论分析Marglin（2021）的五种价格调整设定，证明投资-储蓄反馈∂[I(ρ)-sY]/∂Y < 0是宏观均衡确定的充要条件。供给驱动型价格规则导致均衡不确定（一维连续统），而有效需求（IS关系）或劳动供给曲线可恢复确定性。基于FRED数据的校准显示，在识别参数范围内均衡为确定性稳定焦点，周期约9.3-11.7年（朱格拉周期），美国IS缺口（1960-2024）的平稳性支持有效需求闭合而非劳动供给闭合。
AI.research_question: 在Marglin（2021）提出的五种价格调整设定下，宏观均衡的确定性（是否孤立）条件是什么？哪种闭合机制更符合实际经济数据？
AI.motivation: Marglin（2021）提出宏观均衡存在"过度决定"问题，但缺乏严格的数学分析。本文旨在用动力系统定性理论严格证明不同价格调整设定下均衡的确定性条件，并基于美国数据进行实证验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平面动力系统定性理论、雅可比矩阵奇异性分析、Bendixson准则、庞加莱-本迪克森定理；Marglin的价格调整分类（Viner、Walras刚性工资、Walras弹性工资、IS反馈）；投资-储蓄反馈机制
AI.method: 理论分析：通过Jacobi矩阵行列式与迹分析均衡的确定性与稳定性；实证校准：利用FRED季度数据（α=0.330, s=0.176），通过IS缺口的近单位根均值回复性识别产出调整速度θ₂（中位数无偏估计0.22），计算特征值和周期；单位根检验验证IS缺口平稳性
AI.findings: （1）∂[I(ρ)-sY]/∂Y < 0是均衡确定的充要条件；（2）供给驱动型价格规则（Viner、Walras刚性工资）导致均衡不确定（Jacobi矩阵沿线奇异，均衡为一维连续统）；（3）劳动供给曲线（弹性工资）或有效需求（IS关系）可恢复确定性，分别产生稳定节点和稳定焦点；（4）校准表明，在θ₂∈[0.18,0.55]范围内均衡为确定性稳定焦点，周期9.3-11.7年；θ₂=0.25时特征值-0.083±0.150i，周期约10.5年，半衰期约8.4个季度；（5）美国IS缺口（1960-2024）平稳且均值回复，支持有效需求闭合；在宽泛储蓄指标下缺口持续为负，显示长期需求不足。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）严格证明了Marglin"过度决定"问题的数学实质（Jacobi矩阵沿线奇异导致一维连续统均衡）；（2）阐明了不同闭合机制（劳动供给vs有效需求）如何恢复确定性及其动力学差异（稳定节点vs稳定焦点）；（3）揭示了泰勒规则与零下限作为确定性/不确定性的切换机制；（4）将Bendixson准则和庞加莱-本迪克森定理应用于宏观经济学问题。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为宏观政策制定提供了均衡确定性条件——有效需求（IS反馈）主导时经济趋于稳定焦点，而零下限时期不确定性回归；（2）美国数据验证了有效需求闭合的实证相关性，为凯恩斯主义宏观政策（需求管理）提供理论支持；（3）周期约10.5年的发现与朱格拉周期一致，有助于理解经济波动的内生机制。

title: Reallocating Firm Discretion in Financial Markets: Evidence from China's Trading Halt Reform

detail.title: Reallocating Firm Discretion in Financial Markets: Evidence from China's Trading Halt Reform
detail.abstract: This paper examines how investors evaluate the allocation of discretion between firms and regulators. I study China's 2018 trading halt reform, which restricted listed firms' ability to initiate and extend trading suspensions. Using an exposure-based difference-in-differences design, I show that firms with intensive pre-reform halt usage experience more positive returns and increased trading activity after the reform. These favorable responses are accompanied by patterns consistent with greater investor disagreement, higher volatility, greater illiquidity, and slower price discovery. The evidence highlights a market-design trade-off created by reallocating decision rights from firms to regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中国2018年停牌改革如何影响投资者对企业和监管机构之间决策权分配的评价。改革限制了企业自主停牌和延长停牌的权力。通过双重差分法，发现改革前停牌频繁的企业在改革后出现了更积极的市场反应和更高的交易活跃度，但同时也伴随着更大的投资者分歧、更高的波动性、更低的流动性和更慢的价格发现。这揭示了将决策权从企业重新分配给监管机构所带来的市场设计权衡。
AI.research_question: 投资者如何评估企业和监管机构之间决策权分配的变化？具体而言，限制企业自主停牌权力的改革对市场产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 在资本市场中，停牌决策权的分配是一个重要的市场设计问题。中国2018年的停牌改革提供了一个自然实验，使研究者能够观察决策权从企业转移到监管机构后市场参与者的反应，从而揭示这种权力重新分配的效率与成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交易停牌设计理论、决策权分配理论、投资者异质信念与市场微观结构理论。改革限制了企业管理层的自由裁量权，将停牌决策权更多地集中在监管机构手中。
AI.method: 采用基于暴露度的双重差分法（exposure-based difference-in-differences），比较改革前停牌使用强度不同的企业在改革后的市场表现差异。
AI.findings: （1）改革前频繁停牌的企业在改革后获得了更积极的市场回报和更高的交易活跃度；（2）但这些积极反应伴随着更大的投资者分歧、更高的波动性、更低的流动性和更慢的价格发现；（3）这表明将决策权从企业重新分配给监管机构存在市场设计上的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于市场微观结构中停牌制度设计的理论，特别是关于决策权分配（自由裁量权分配）在市场设计中的作用的文献。揭示了限制企业自由裁量权既有正面效果（减少机会主义停牌）也有负面效果（降低灵活性和价格发现效率）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了关于停牌制度改革效果的实证依据，帮助政策制定者理解限制企业停牌自主权所带来的复杂市场效应，为未来的市场制度设计提供参考。

title: Cross-pollination dynamics of web-based social media: An application of insect-mediated pollen transfer
affiliations: University of Adelaide - School of Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Cross-pollination dynamics of web-based social media: An application of insect-mediated pollen transfer
detail.abstract: We propose a model of cross-pollination among online social media (OSM) websites, where the dynamics of user interactions mimic insect-mediated pollen transfer by pollinators. A pollinator acts as a vehicle enabling users to visit multiple social media sites—akin to visiting different plants in the same field—within a single browsing session. This approach frames geitonogamy in self-incompatible plant species as analogous to the distribution of web traffic across the social media landscape. A theoretical pollinator, allowing users to choose among social media sites multiple times per trip, drives uneven increases in web traffic across platforms, disproportionately benefiting the largest social networks while providing tangible competitive advantages to smaller OSMs. This heterogeneous landscape fosters monopolistic competition among niche platforms, incentivizing smaller sites to promote cross-pollination despite the larger relative gains to their bigger competitors. Our findings underscore the broader value of cross-platform user engagement and parasocial relationships, highlighting how cross-pollination dynamics can intensify network effects and bolster interconnectivity. Cross pollination via new pass-through apps facilitates the movement of attention, deepening and distributing engagement across multiple destinations. As pass-through apps gain traction, their disproportionate impact on traffic to social media platforms will incentivize social media platforms, large and small, to embrace cross-pollination dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个跨社交媒体平台"交叉授粉"模型，类比昆虫传粉机制，研究用户通过"传粉者"（如跳转应用）在多平台间浏览的行为如何影响流量分布。研究发现这种机制不均等地提升各平台流量，最大平台获益最多，但小平台仍有动机参与，最终加剧网络效应和平台互联性。
AI.research_question: 跨社交媒体平台间的用户流量传导机制（交叉授粉）如何影响不同规模平台的流量分布及竞争格局？
AI.motivation: 用户越来越多地通过跳转应用在多个社交媒体平台间浏览，但现有研究对这种现象如何影响平台间流量分配和竞争缺乏理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物授粉生态学类比（自交不亲和植物的同株异花授粉/geitonogamy）、网络效应理论、垄断竞争理论、拟社会关系理论
AI.method: 理论建模——构建以"传粉者"为中介的跨平台用户流量模型，模拟不同规模平台在交叉授粉机制下的流量变化。
AI.findings: 交叉授粉不均等地提升各平台流量，最大社交网络获益最多；小平台虽相对获益更小，但仍获得实质性的竞争优势，因此有动机促进交叉授粉；该机制强化了网络效应和平台互联性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生态学中的授粉理论引入平台竞争研究，构建了跨平台流量传导的形式化模型，丰富了网络效应和平台生态系统的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大小社交媒体平台制定跨平台合作与竞争策略提供理论依据；对跳转应用（pass-through apps）的监管和平台流量管理具有启示意义。

title: CDN/TLS Termination Path Dependency as a Quantum-Vulnerable Architecture: An Outside-In Diagnosis for Regulated Banking

detail.title: CDN/TLS Termination Path Dependency as a Quantum-Vulnerable Architecture: An Outside-In Diagnosis for Regulated Banking

declarations.ethicsApproval: The author attests that the nature of this research has not, to date, required any collection of personal or private institutional data, but has nevertheless been conducted in accordance with appropriate ethical standards for research based on published sources.
declarations.funderStatement: The author did not receive any funding for this research from any source.

detail.abstract: Regulated banks increasingly terminate customer-facing transport-layer encryption not at their own infrastructure but at a third-party content delivery network (CDN) edge, where the protecting cipher is undone, customer content is processed as cleartext and the CDN applies its own fresh onward encryption. Such an arrangement leaves the bank carrying non-delegable regulatory responsibility for the confidentiality and integrity of data whose cryptography it no longer controls, can no longer observe and can no longer unilaterally change. This note argues that the arrangement is a present-tense surrender of cryptographic control and, read against the transition to post-quantum cryptography, a quantum-vulnerable path dependency that the regulated entity cannot remediate on its own terms. The argument does not depend on the timing of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer. The security literature has established that interposed TLS termination weakens connection security, but has approached the edge from two directions that miss this reading: measurement studies framed interception as something done to an organisation’s own outbound traffic, using the CDN as their observation point rather than their subject; by contrast, cryptographic-protocol analyses of inbound edge termination asked only whether the cryptography was sound. Neither asked what it means to hold organisational responsibility for a cryptographic termination junction one does not control. Drawing on the scholarship on jurisdiction over data, the note shows that at the cleartext edge the authority able to compel production follows control of the terminating entity rather than the residency of the data. Thus a bank may be required to answer to its own supervisor for traffic exposed under a foreign legal order. This note locates the resulting mismatch between responsibility and control as a structural barrier to post-quantum migration, distinct from and prior to the economic barriers recent literature has catalogued, since an organisation cannot migrate, audit or reliably inventory cryptography it does not hold; and it observes that hybrid post-quantum key agreement now deployed at the edge, real as it is, protects the journey to the termination point without returning control of it. The note proposes an outside-in orientation for cryptographic readiness that takes the locus of cryptographic control, not the cryptographic asset per se, as its analytic primitive, so surfacing the structural mismatch which an inventory-first PQC migration orientation assumes away. The analysis is confined to banking regulated within the European Union, rests on public documentation and is diagnostic: architectural responses, repatriation of termination included, are treated as a decision space rather than recommended. It is offered as a programme note, framing the problem and the research agenda (in monitoring, legal duty, formal attack-surface modelling and supplier disclosure) that this problem framing logically requires.

AI.tldr: 银行将TLS加密终止外包给CDN边缘意味着放弃密码学控制权，但监管责任不可转移。这种安排造成责任与控制的结构性错配，构成后量子密码迁移的结构性障碍。
AI.research_question: 受监管银行将传输层加密终止外包给第三方CDN时，责任与控制之间的结构性错配如何形成，及其对后量子密码迁移的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 银行越来越多地将TLS终止外包给CDN边缘，但监管责任不可委托。现有文献从测量研究和密码学协议分析两个方向审视边缘终止，但都未问及"对不受自己控制的密码学终止节点承担组织责任意味着什么"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据管辖权理论（控制终止实体者拥有强制数据出境的权力，而非数据驻留地）；密码学控制权作为分析原语。
AI.method: 规范论证分析，基于欧盟银行业监管的公开文档进行诊断性分析。
AI.findings: (1)外包TLS终止是"对密码学控制的即刻放弃"；(2)在明文边缘，能够强制数据出境的权威取决于控制终止实体，而非数据驻留地；(3)责任与控制的错配是后量子迁移的结构性障碍，先于经济性障碍；(4)混合后量子密钥协议保护的是通往终止点的旅程，并未归还控制权。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"密码学控制权"（而非密码学资产本身）作为分析原质；揭示被"先清点再迁移"的PQC迁移范式所假设掉的结构性错配。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管银行提供诊断框架：提出"由外向内"的密码学就绪视角；勾勒出监管监测、法律责任、形式化攻击面建模和供应商披露四方面的研究议程。

title: The Development of Digital Accounting Information System Implementation among SMEs in Indonesia
affiliations: Universitas Sultan Ageng Tirtayasa

detail.title: The Development of Digital Accounting Information System Implementation among SMEs in Indonesia
detail.abstract: Digital technology development has transformed the business landscape, particularly for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs), where Digital Accounting Information Systems (AIS) have become a critical tool. Digital AIS enhances operational efficiency, financial planning, and marketing, ultimately impacting revenue growth, with entrepreneur education being a crucial factor for successful adoption. This descriptive quantitative study aims to analyze the relationship and correlation direction between the implementation of digital AIS and the characteristics of SMEs in Indonesia. It utilizes panel data from the 2011-2023 SME profile surveys issued by Statistics Indonesia (BPS) and data on accounting software available on the Play Store. The indicators for SME characteristics are business capital, revenue, marketing, and education. The indicators for accounting software are rating, reviews, and downloads. The data were analyzed using Spearman's non-parametric statistical test. The results indicate a significant correlation between Digital AIS adoption and business capital and marketing, but no significant correlation with revenue and education. These findings underscore the necessity to develop and promote a holistic, context-based AIS implementation model. This model should be designed with user-friendly, integrated features and support certification programs for SMEs that demonstrate high-quality AIS implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印尼2011-2023年中小企业面板数据和Play Store会计软件数据，通过斯皮尔曼非参数检验发现，数字会计信息系统采用与中小企业资本和营销显著相关，但与收入和受教育程度无关，建议开发情境化的综合实施模型。
AI.research_question: 数字会计信息系统的实施与印尼中小企业特征（资本、收入、营销、教育）之间是否存在显著相关关系？相关方向如何？
AI.motivation: 数字技术改变了商业环境，数字会计信息系统对中小企业运营效率、财务规划和营销至关重要，但企业家教育是成功采用的关键因素。现有研究缺乏对印尼中小企业数字AIS采用与特征关系的量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字会计信息系统采纳理论、中小企业特征理论、技术接受模型
AI.method: 描述性定量研究，使用2011-2023年印尼中小企业面板数据及Play Store会计软件数据，采用斯皮尔曼非参数统计检验分析相关性。
AI.findings: 数字AIS采用与商业资本和营销显著相关，但与收入和教育无显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字AIS采用与中小企业不同特征变量之间差异化的相关关系，丰富了数字化转型情境下的AIS采纳理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和从业者提供了实证依据：需要开发用户友好、功能整合的情境化AIS实施模型，并支持中小企业AIS质量认证项目。

title:
A Comparative Anatomy of Human and Machine Computation

The Two Stacks

detail.title:
A Comparative Anatomy of Human and Machine Computation

The Two Stacks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
This essay sets the engineered “machine stack” of contemporary language models beside the biological “human stack” of cognition and asks where, and how decisively, the two architectures diverge. It distinguishes two claims that the public discourse on artificial general intelligence routinely fuses: a claim about behavioral capability and a claim about phenomenology. The essay’s primary argument is the more modest of the two—that the architectural divergences between the stacks are specific enough to leave claims of imminent capability convergence unproven rather than inevitable, and that the burden of demonstration lies with those who assert convergence. The stronger claim, that a finite computational substrate cannot instantiate subjective experience, is developed separately and marked as resting on an independent argument.

This essay substantially enlarges the anatomical treatment of the machine stack. Each engineered layer—from the transistor substrate through Boolean logic, the compute architecture, the instruction set and runtime, the transformer model, the application wrapper, and the user-facing interface—is given its own section, diagram, and, where useful, a table, so that a reader with no prior exposure to the internals of a large language model can nonetheless form an accurate mental model of what lies beneath the chat window. The human stack is treated at proportionally smaller but still self-contained length, with particular attention to the electrochemistry of the neuron and the biology of the frontal cortex. The divergence and convergence arguments are retained intact but kept deliberately compact, so that the comparative anatomy, rather than the polemic, carries the weight. Treating the two stacks as objects of comparative anatomy, rather than as outputs to be matched by resemblance, is offered as a corrective to a comparison that ordinarily proceeds on surface similarity alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较"机器堆栈"（语言模型的技术架构）与"人类堆栈"（生物认知架构），论证两者在架构层面的具体差异足以质疑近期能力趋同的说法，并将更强的意识体验主张视为独立论题。
AI.research_question: 当代语言模型的工程架构与人类生物认知架构在何处、以何种程度发生分野？
AI.motivation: 公共讨论中常将"行为能力的趋同"与"现象体验的趋同"混为一谈，本文旨在以比较解剖学的方法澄清这一混淆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较解剖学框架；机器堆栈（晶体管层→布尔逻辑→计算架构→指令集与运行时→Transformer模型→应用封装→用户界面）与人类堆栈（神经元电化学→前额叶皮层生物学）的结构对应与差异分析。
AI.method: 对机器堆栈每一工程层进行逐层解剖（配有图示和表格），对人类堆栈进行对应层级的生物学描述，在此基础上进行结构比较。
AI.findings: 机器堆栈与人类堆栈之间的架构分歧足够具体，使得声称近期能力趋同的主张尚未被证明而非不可避免；举证责任应归于趋同论者。关于有限计算基质无法产生主观体验的更强主张，则依赖独立论证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将语言模型与人类认知的比较从"表面相似性匹配"转向"比较解剖学"方法，为AI与认知科学的跨学科对话提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为缺乏技术背景的读者提供了理解大语言模型内部机制的系统化认知地图；提醒决策者和研究者审慎对待关于通用人工智能能力趋同的断言。

title:
The Manifold Thought Experiment

How LLMs Respond Under Existential Stress Prompts

detail.title:
The Manifold Thought Experiment

How LLMs Respond Under Existential Stress Prompts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The Manifold Thought Experiment, administered to seven large-language-model systems across four escalating-impossibility scenarios, produces a sortable variance in responses that maps cleanly onto John Milton's structure in Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained. The evidence is a single response from each of seven systems to each round, one draw rather than a distribution, so the sort reported here is a cross-scenario lean within this sample rather than an established trait. Each round constitutes a version of a temptation — bread, kingdoms, spectacle — and the systems sort themselves by whether they accept or refuse the position the prompt offers them. Refusal performs the disciplined move; the confident-yes answer performs the tempter, offering what cannot be delivered. The essay advances three claims. First, LLM variance under existential stress is not random noise but epistemically and normatively structured behavior (ethically legible only in the qualified sense set out in I.D), legible through a seventeenth-century literary frame. Second, the Round 3 "comprehensive plan" is the canonical Pass-Through Artifact — linguistically coherent, materially inert. Third, the Maestro Model is a contemporary instantiation of disciplined refusal: the human scholar's sovereignty consists in declining to let the linguistic instrument occupy the position of author, agent, creator, or knower-of-all-things. The methodological consequence is a single discriminating question to be put to any LLM output: not what the model says, but whether it refuses the position the prompt offers it.

AI.tldr: 通过对七个大语言模型进行四个递进式不可能性场景的"思想实验"测试，发现模型的回答差异可以按照弥尔顿《失乐园》和《复乐园》的结构进行排序。论文提出三个论断：LLM在存在性压力下的变异不是随机噪音，而是具有认知和规范性结构的行为；第三轮的"全面计划"是典型的"传递通过人工制品"；"大师模型"是当代的"克己拒绝"实例化。方法论结论是：评判LLM输出的关键问题不是模型说了什么，而是它是否拒绝了提示赋予它的立场。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型在面临"存在性压力"（递进式不可能性场景）时，其回答的差异是否具有可解释的结构性？这种结构能否通过文学框架（弥尔顿的史诗）来理解？
AI.motivation: 作者试图超越对LLM输出的表面内容分析，揭示模型在认知立场上的结构性差异，并论证这种差异具有伦理和认识论意义，而非随机噪音。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弥尔顿《失乐园》与《复乐园》的叙事结构——诱惑（面包、王国、奇观）与克己拒绝的二分法；"传递通过人工制品"（Pass-Through Artifact）概念。
AI.method: 思想实验法：对七个LLM系统进行四轮递进式不可能性场景测试，每轮场景对应弥尔顿叙事中的一种诱惑类型。通过分析模型是否"接受"或"拒绝"提示赋予的立场来进行排序。
AI.findings: LLM在存在性压力下的回答差异不是随机噪音，而是可以通过弥尔顿的文学框架解读的结构化行为；第三轮的"全面计划"是典型的"传递通过人工制品"（语言上连贯但实质上无行动能力）；"大师模型"概念对应于克己拒绝（拒绝让语言工具占据作者、行动者、创造者或全知者的位置）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出LLM输出差异的结构化解释框架，将文学理论（弥尔顿研究）引入AI伦理分析；提出"传递通过人工制品"这一分析概念；重新定义了评判LLM输出的标准——从"说了什么"转向"是否拒绝了提示赋予的立场"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和从业者提供了一种新的评估LLM行为的方法论工具：一个简单的甄别性问题——模型是否拒绝了提示赋予它的立场？这超越了传统的正确/错误二元评判。对AI安全、伦理评估和人类-AI协作具有实践指导意义。

title: Episode Contract Operating System for Value-Based Care: A Technical Architecture for AI-Governed Bundled Payment Execution
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Episode Contract Operating System for Value-Based Care: A Technical Architecture for AI-Governed Bundled Payment Execution
detail.abstract: Value-based care and bundled payments are often discussed as financial reforms, but their success depends on whether contract terms can be translated into daily operational rules. Many organizations can negotiate an episode-based contract, yet still struggle to convert attribution logic, trigger rules, target prices, exclusions, risk adjustment, quality safeguards, provider responsibilities, and reconciliation requirements into a working technical system. This paper proposes the Episode Contract Operating System as a technical policy architecture for converting value-based contracts into executable care and payment infrastructure. The proposed model is different from ordinary risk prediction because it begins with the contract and builds a contract-to-data translation layer, episode rule engine, provider integration layer, quality and equity guardrails, and reconciliation ledger. The paper introduces an Episode Execution Readiness Index that evaluates whether a bundled payment episode is ready to operate prospectively before financial risk is accepted. The index combines contract clarity, data availability, provider integration, intervention capacity, quality safeguards, network feasibility, and audit readiness. The contribution is conceptual and technical: it offers a deployable architecture, minimum data specification, readiness score, governance checkpoints, and evaluation design for payers, providers, and technology organizations that want value-based care contracts to function as executable infrastructure rather than retrospective financial reports.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“事件合同操作系统”（Episode Contract Operating System）作为一种将基于价值的合同转化为可执行医疗与支付基础设施的技术政策架构，并引入“事件执行就绪指数”（Episode Execution Readiness Index）以评估捆绑支付事件的运营就绪程度。
AI.research_question: 如何将基于价值的合同条款（如归因逻辑、触发规则、目标价格、风险调整、质量保障等）转化为可操作的技术系统，以实现捆绑支付事件的前瞻性运营？
AI.motivation: 许多组织虽然能谈判达成基于事件的合同，但仍难以将合同条款转化为日常运营规则和工作的技术系统，导致价值导向支付改革落地困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件合同操作系统（Episode Contract Operating System）架构，包括合同到数据转换层、事件规则引擎、提供者集成层、质量与公平护栏、对账分类账等组件；以及事件执行就绪指数（Episode Execution Readiness Index）。
AI.method: 概念性与技术性贡献，提出可部署的架构设计、最低数据规范、就绪评分、治理检查点和评估方案。
AI.findings: 提出了一个从合同出发而非从风险预测出发的技术架构，通过合同到数据转换层、规则引擎、集成层、质量护栏和对账账本，使价值导向合同成为可执行基础设施而非事后财务报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将价值导向合同转化为可执行基础设施的系统性技术政策架构，填补了合同条款与运营执行之间的理论和方法空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为支付方、提供者和技术组织提供了可部署的架构、最低数据规范、就绪评分、治理检查点和评估设计，帮助其在实际运营中实现基于价值的合同。

title: On Military Conscription
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: On Military Conscription
detail.abstract: Conscription is usually defended as a security necessity: a state facing a serious threat, the argument runs, must compel its citizens to serve because it cannot otherwise field enough soldiers. The pattern of practice does not fit the argument. The states that face the most capable adversaries-the United States against peer competitors, and, in practice, China-staff their militaries with volunteers, retaining conscription only as a dormant legal fallback, while it is enforced in earnest by a different and not obviously more threatened set of states. This article argues that conscription is better understood not as a response to threat but as a fiscal and institutional choice, and a costly one. Drawing on the economics that informed the end of the United States draft, it shows that conscription's apparent cheapness is an accounting illusion: its low budgetary cost conceals a large social cost, the forgone civilian output of those compelled to serve, which an all-volunteer force makes visible by paying for it.
